detail.title: Booking
detail.notFound: This booking does not exist or has been removed

actionBar.closedHint: This booking is closed and can no longer be edited
actionBar.confirmPermissionHint: The handovers.confirm permission is required to confirm a handover

dialog.cancelLead: A cancelled booking cannot be reopened. The vehicle is freed immediately, so someone else may take this slot.
dialog.noShowLead: Marking a no-show closes the booking for good. The vehicle is freed immediately, so someone else may take this slot.
dialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. customer cancelled by phone, vehicle broke down…
dialog.reasonHelp: The reason is kept in the booking log for later reference; the customer never sees it.
dialog.paidTitle: {amount} has already been recorded as collected
dialog.paidDescription: XePrime does not refund automatically and does not delete what has been recorded. To pay the customer back, transfer the money outside the app and then record an expense in the shop ledger.

statusActions.noShowHint: Available only {minutes} minutes past pickup time, and only while the vehicle has not been handed over.

list.title: Bookings
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by customer name, phone or booking code
list.emptyTitle: This shop has no bookings yet
list.emptyBody: A booking appears when you approve a rental request, or when you create one at the counter.
list.emptyFilteredTitle: No bookings found for these filters
list.emptyFilteredBody: Change the status or drop the search term to see the full list.

money.otherCollected: of which via the cash book
money.note: Every figure is computed by the system from receipts and surcharges — it cannot be edited directly.

driver.title: Driver
driver.sheetTitle: Pick a driver available for this booking window
driver.noneWithDriver: Chauffeured booking — no driver assigned yet

deliveryFee.title: Delivery fee
deliveryFee.label: Delivery fee (VND)
deliveryFee.hint: The map figure is an estimate — you decide the final fee after agreeing with the customer.
deliveryFee.notePlaceholder: e.g. agreed by phone, delivery to Thu Duc
deliveryFee.noteHint: Stored in the booking log for reconciliation only — the customer never sees it.

handover.readOnly: This handover is confirmed and read-only. Correcting the odometer needs the adjustment flow.
handover.notEligible: The booking status does not allow opening this handover direction.
handover.errorTitle: Could not load the handover record

odometer.placeholder: Leave blank if you could not read it
odometer.hintWithCurrent: Currently recorded: {km}. You can confirm without entering it.
odometer.hintPlain: You can confirm without entering it. Left blank, the vehicle mileage stays as is.

notes.label: Note
notes.placeholder: e.g. handed over at the lot, customer received all documents

photos.title: Condition photos
photos.uploadFailed: Upload failed. The photo stays queued — retry when you have signal.
photos.removeConfirm: Remove this photo from the record? Condition photos are evidence — removing means shooting it again.
photos.sourceHint: Take a new photo or pick an existing one. Photos are compressed before upload so they go through on weak signal.
photos.unavailable: Could not open the photo. View links live only a few minutes — tap again for a fresh one.
photos.optional: Optional — a normal trip is done in exactly two taps.
photos.afterConfirm: Photos can still be added after confirmation.

confirm.title: Confirm this handover?
confirm.pickupLead: Confirming records the odometer on the vehicle profile and moves the booking to In progress. After this the record is read-only.
confirm.returnLead: Confirming records the odometer on the vehicle profile and closes the booking (Completed). After this the record is read-only.

conflict.title: Someone just edited this record
conflict.body: Another person saved this handover while you were typing. The latest data has been reloaded — review it and try again.

odometerFix.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. re-read from the odometer photo on the record
odometerFix.reasonHint: Required and written to the audit log — an odometer that changes with no explanation is something that must not exist.
odometerFix.decreaseForbidden: Lowering the odometer needs a separate permission (vehicles.odometer.decrease). Reducing it can hide distance actually driven, so it is not part of ordinary edit rights.
odometerFix.missingTitle: This record is missing its odometer reading
odometerFix.missingBody: The vehicle's current odometer has not been updated from this trip. Enter the actual reading to sync the vehicle profile and its maintenance milestones.
odometerFix.decreaseTitle: The new reading is lower than the current one
odometerFix.decreaseConfirm: Lowering the odometer can hide distance already driven, so it takes one more confirmation.
odometerFix.decreaseOverride: I have authority, lower it anyway

handover.photosHint: Photograph the vehicle so there is evidence at the end of the trip. Optional — you can confirm without it.
handover.returnDepositNotice: With no surcharges, the system proposes refunding the full deposit received. The owner makes the refund outside the app and marks it afterwards — it does not block completing the trip.
handover.odometerBelowPickup: The return odometer ({entered} km) cannot be lower than the pickup odometer ({pickup} km).

occurredAt.hint: {time} — defaults to the scheduled time; adjust it if handover ran late or early.

supplement.title: Add handover details
supplement.emptyBody: You can add photos once pickup or return has been confirmed.
supplement.confirmedBody: Photos added from now on are recorded as later additions, with their real upload time. Mileage and handover time cannot be changed here.

settlement.title: Trip settlement
settlement.depositRequiredHint: This is the configured amount — it may not have been collected.
settlement.additionalDueHint: Surcharges exceed the deposit received. Collect the difference directly from the customer.
settlement.formulaNote: The refund and the amount still due are computed from the deposit held and the surcharges.

surcharges.title: Surcharges
surcharges.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. returned 6 hours late due to traffic out of province
surcharges.reasonHint: This is deducted from the customer — the reason is required and they can read it.

overtime.title: Late-return fee suggestion
overtime.unavailable: Not enough data to suggest a late fee (policy or actual return time missing).

refund.title: Deposit refund
refund.correctionReasonHint: The reason and the previous values both go to the audit log.
refund.disclaimer: XePrime only RECORDS the status. You transfer the money to the customer outside the app.
refund.amountHint: Proposed: {amount}. Adjust if the actual amount differs.
refund.correctionReasonPlaceholder: e.g. wrong amount entered, reconciled against the statement

settlement.needsMoreBody: Surcharges exceed the deposit received. Collect the difference directly from the customer.
settlement.noticeNotReceived: No deposit collection has been recorded for this booking, so there is nothing to refund. Record the deposit payment under Payments if you have received it.
settlement.noticeReceived: Holding the customer deposit. Refunding opens after the vehicle is returned and surcharges are finalised.
settlement.noticeSettled: Surcharges consumed the whole deposit received — nothing left to refund.

payments.title: Payment history
payments.errorTitle: Could not load the payment history
payments.depositHint: A deposit is money held in trust — it does NOT count towards the booking as paid.
payments.voidConfirm: Refund this transaction? The paid amount will be deducted again.
payments.manualOnly: XePrime does not take payments. This is bookkeeping for what happened at the counter.
payments.depositNoticeTitle: A deposit does not reduce the balance due
payments.depositNoticeBody: A deposit is the customer’s property held in trust and returned at the end of the trip — it appears in the cash book but does not reduce what the customer still owes in rent.

create.title: New counter booking

schedule.title: Rental period
schedule.conflict: This vehicle is already booked for that period. Pick another window or another vehicle.

customer.title: Customer details
customer.notePlaceholder: Anything worth keeping for this trip

price.title: Price and deposit
price.depositHint: A deposit is money held in trust — it is not rental income.
price.note: Enter what you agreed with the customer. Leave blank to use the shop pricing policy.

create.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to create bookings.

missingKm.errorTitle: Could not load the missing-odometer list
missingKm.resolveForbiddenTitle: No permission to open this handover record
missingKm.resolveForbiddenBody: Filling in the odometer needs view access to that booking’s handover.
missingKm.resolveErrorTitle: Could not load the handover record
missingKm.resolveErrorBody: The connection may have dropped. This task stays in the queue.
missingKm.emptyBody: Every return record has an odometer reading — the fleet's numbers are complete.

edit.title: Edit booking
edit.vehicleLocked: The vehicle cannot be changed on an existing booking. Cancel it and create a new one instead.
edit.closedHint: This booking is closed and can no longer be edited.
edit.scheduleNote: Changing the dates moves the slot this booking holds on the calendar — the system re-checks on save.
edit.deliveryFeeNote: Edit the delivery fee in the "Cost summary" block — only there can the reason be written to the audit log.
edit.conflictTitle: This vehicle is already booked for that window
edit.conflictBody: Pick another vehicle, or change the pickup/return time.

trip.title: Trip management
trip.notStarted: Trip has not started. Tap “Confirm handover” when you give the vehicle to the customer.
trip.inProgress: The customer has the vehicle. Tap “Confirm return” when they bring it back.
trip.ended: This booking ended early — the handover history is read-only.

contract.title: Vehicle rental agreement
contract.term1: Party B collects and returns the vehicle at the agreed time and place, and takes proper care of it.
contract.term2: Party B is liable for traffic violations, damage and loss arising during the rental period.
contract.term3: The deposit is refunded after the vehicle is returned, less any surcharges.
contract.term4: Both parties settle matters between themselves in good faith; XePrime is only the connecting platform.

staffBooking.pickVehicle: Pick a vehicle for the booking
staffBooking.title: Book for a customer
staffBooking.packageRequired: Pick a long-term package before continuing.
staffBooking.derivedReturn: Return date: {value} — computed by the server in calendar months.
staffBooking.deliveryFeeNote: The delivery fee stays 0 at creation — the owner records the agreed fee later.
staffBooking.conflict: This vehicle is already booked for that window. Please pick another time.
staffBooking.conflictOnCreate: The vehicle was just booked for this window. Go back to Time and pick another range.
staffBooking.quoteUnavailable: This vehicle has no pricing set — enter the rental fee and deposit before creating the booking.
staffBooking.manualBaseRequired: This vehicle has no pricing set — enter the rental fee before creating the booking.
staffBooking.quoteSavings: You save {amount} with the {package} term discount.
staffBooking.quoteUnavailableAtTime: This vehicle has no daily rate set — you will enter the rental fee at the Confirm step.
staffBooking.packageHint: Pick a package so the system can quote.
staffBooking.routeNote: Route: {route} — change it at the Time step if needed.
staffBooking.pickupSelfHint: The customer collects the vehicle at the shop location
staffBooking.pickupDeliveryHint: The shop brings the vehicle to the address the customer gives
staffBooking.doneHeld: The vehicle is now held for the customer. The schedule updates automatically.
staffBooking.pickupAtEmpty: Choose the pickup date and time
staffBooking.derivedReturnEmpty: Pick a package and pickup time to see the return date.
